in_sanskrit.name: Shura
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has the power and the courage to face any challenge and emerge victorious.

in_hindi.name: सूरव
in_hindi.long_meaning: शूरवर (शूर + वर) = शूर (brave, powerful) + वर (blessing) = One who is blessed with courage and strength.

in_tamil.name: சூரவ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: சூரவர் (சூர + வர்) = சூர (ஶூர் = ஶூர்வான், a hero) + வர் (வரும் = விஜயத்தினால், victorious) = One who is a victorious hero.

in_telugu.name: శూరవ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శూరవర్ (శూర + వర్) = శూర (శూర్ = శూర్వేశ్, a hero) + వర్ (దేశించే, blessed) = One who is blessed with the qualities of a hero and is victorious.

in_marathi.name: Sourav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sourav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A victorious and powerful one

in_bengali.name: Sourav
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sourav একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A victorious and powerful one
